actions.action: Lift cutting out and rinse roots under running water
Sterilize scissors with rubbing alcohol and trim black, mushy roots and soft dark stem sections
Check dark bumps with a fingernail; if scale, dab with rubbing alcohol on a cotton swab and rinse
Wash jar with dish soap and hot water, rinse, refill with fresh water keeping only nodes submerged
Change the water every 5–7 days or sooner if cloudy or smelly
Place plant in bright, indirect light
If no new roots in ~3 weeks or stem keeps darkening, take a cutting above damage with a node and root in fresh water

reason: The answer correctly identifies root rot from topping off stagnant water and gives the rinse, trim and full-water-change fix, but it omits fertilizer and a larger container, so the advice is incomplete; nothing in it is harmful.
